whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text:
Ocean cloud.
I always feel that clouds and oceans are very similar.
They're the same thing as far as imagery goes.
It's a rainbow hologram, so when you move it up and down,
it's going to change different colors.
And you'll get, because they're tilted different ways,
you'll get different colors, different color combinations.
And I really wanted to make that happen
with the different kind of colors that I made off of it.
Okay, the markings on the floor I made
because it's a very static piece.
The holograms are just, it's just a hologram.
And you really have to do a holographic dance to see it.
It doesn't move for you.
It's just one light.
And you have to like move around to see the different objects
and the different colors.
Move up and down, you see the different colors.
Move side to side, you see the movement of the object.
The first hologram is somewhere out here.
It's, and if you come close to it, it will collapse,
but you'll just see the colors.
But if you move back and forth, you can see the cloud imagery.
If you move up and down, you can see the color.
And so you have to move around to see it.
All these different positions give you different color combinations.
